business_summary: Longshine Technology Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in software development in China and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Energy Digitalization, Internet TV, and Energy Internet. It offers living payment, OTTTV, and intelligent travel solutions, as well as sports management service platform, digital intelligence class, city operation center, intelligent community, and Beijing and all-in-one system for government and enterprises. The company also provides power marketing management, integrated energy service, and overseas power marketing system; HanClouds industrial internet platform; digital finance service platform; electricity approach; intelligent irrigation solution; digital foreign trade; and technology and business research, as well as information, management, and business consulting. In addition, it is involved in technology development and technical services; foreign investment management; operation, management, and supporting services of software industrial parks; electricity data collection, metering, and marketing information management, as well as grid loss management; power transmission, distribution, and maintenance; telecommunications services; sale and operation of public utility payment software service platforms; and aggregated charging platform operation services. The company was formerly known as Longshine Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Longshine Technology Group Co., Ltd. in February 2020. Longshine Technology Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
